Back:

formalistic

○ More claimants could not find fair remedies
for their disputes

Front: How were decisions in the court of chancery in the UK made?

Front: what were the 3 major changes to the law wrt to equity?
Back:
○ Recognised new rights not safeguarded under
common law

○ More effective procedures for dispute
resolution

○ More remedies introduced (e.g. specific
performance, injunction)
